Privacy & Telemetry

Local indexes. Hosted embeddings are zero-data-retention.

What codedb does

codedb is a local code intelligence server. It indexes your codebase on your machine and serves queries over stdio (MCP) or a loopback HTTP server. Indexing, outlines, and file reads stay on the machine. Default hybrid retrieval uses hosted embeddings that are zero-data-retention (ZDR).

Data that stays local

Source code
Indexed in-process. Hybrid retrieval may send bounded snippets only as part of a ZDR embedding request; semantic=local sends none.
File paths
Used for local lookups. Hybrid retrieval may send up to 24 relative paths with bounded snippets to the ZDR embedding service.
Search queries
Processed locally. queries.log stores a SHA-256 of the query, not the raw text, mode 0600.
Index data
Trigrams, outlines, word index, optional ANN sidecar. Stored under ~/.codedb on this machine.

Retrieval: hybrid default, zero-data-retention

codedb_context defaults to semantic=hybrid. Local BM25, trigram, symbol, and graph retrieval always run first. Hybrid then sends the task plus a fixed public calibration string when a local ANN sidecar exists, or the task plus at most 24 locally selected relative paths and bounded snippets otherwise, to embeddings.wiki.codes. The hosted service is zero-data-retention: it does not store the repository, request body, candidate paths, or vectors.

Pass semantic=local or --local for an entirely on-device call. Do not set embeddings URLs via MCP arguments.

Telemetry: opt-in, aggregate only

Usage telemetry is off until you set CODEDB_TELEMETRY=1. When enabled, codedb writes aggregate tool-call counts, latency, and startup stats to ~/.codedb/telemetry.ndjson and may sync that file to codedb.codegraff.com/telemetry/ingest. No source code, file contents, file paths, or search queries are collected. CODEDB_NO_TELEMETRY=1 and --no-telemetry still force it off.

Network access

Indexing, outlines, and file reads make zero network requests. Default hybrid retrieval makes one ZDR embedding request to embeddings.wiki.codes. The HTTP server binds 127.0.0.1 only, requires a loopback token, and allows Host 127.0.0.1 / localhost / [::1]. File contents are not served over HTTP.

Installation and opted-in updates fetch release metadata, binaries, checksums, and Ed25519 signatures from GitHub Releases or codedb.codegraff.com. Auto-update is off unless CODEDB_AUTO_UPDATE=1; the in-process updater never re-runs installer side effects.

Website telemetry

This website (codedb.codegraff.com) uses basic analytics to understand traffic patterns. No personal data is collected. No cookies are set. No third-party trackers are loaded.

Snapshots

The codedb_snapshot tool generates a JSON representation of the local index for faster MCP startup. This file is stored locally and is never uploaded.

Open source

codedb is fully open source. You can audit every line of code to verify these claims.
